title: Leveraging a Multi-Agent LLM-Based System to Educate Teachers in Hate Incidents Management

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the classification accuracy of explicit and implicit hate speech using the HateXplain and Latent Hatred benchmark datasets across different LLM agent configurations.
Using Advisory Agents with distinct personas to simulate and analyze how different cultural backgrounds and lived experiences affect the subjective interpretation of potentially hateful content.

Employing a multi-agent LLM system simulating different academic disciplines (e.g., psychology, pedagogy) to model varying perspectives and demonstrate the nature of annotator disagreements in hate speech detection.
